title: 第9章 你们有几个师胆子这么大第10章 阁下就是老夫的有缘人
slug: 都市修仙五年下山就无敌
content_zh:
“好哒麻麻。”
小丫头蹦蹦跳跳去洗手。
四菜一汤，都是很家常的菜，味道让叶凡赞不绝口。
“盈盈，你这手艺真棒。”
“嗯嗯嗯，麻麻是天底下最棒的麻麻，做的饭太好吃啦。”
叶子扬起可爱纯真的小脸，一边夸，一边偷偷将碗里的青菜挑到叶凡碗里，然后大口吃肉。
“……”叶凡。
“……”柳盈盈。
小孩子总是这样，自以为做的事天衣无缝，其实只是父母不想拆穿罢了。
柳盈盈这次也装作没看到。
许是玩累了的缘故，叶子比平常多吃了半碗饭，吃完还摸了摸小肚肚，特别可爱。
“叶子，我去放水，一会儿要泡澡哦。”
“爸爸也来。”
好闺女！
叶凡差点就答应了。
可迎上柳盈盈平淡如水的眼神，叶凡苦口婆心劝道：“叶子啊，你是五岁的大姑娘了，爸爸不能陪你一起。”
“好吧。”
小丫头有些失望。
叶凡又陪小叶子玩了会积木，等女儿被柳盈盈喊走后，便恋恋不舍去了一楼客卧。
因为没有换洗衣服，洗完澡的叶凡赤身躺在床上放空思绪。

相比较昆仑山的浓郁灵气，别墅及方圆十里的灵气稀薄到约等于没有，所以叶凡并没有吐纳，而是望着月色发呆。
今晚月色真美。
比昆仑山上的月亮好看多了。
“叶凡，你睡了没有。”
柳盈盈推开门，霞飞红晕，因为灯开着，一切的一切尽收眼底。
她连忙转过身，嗔恼道：“你怎么不穿衣服！”
“你怎么不敲门？”
叶凡惊慌失措的捂着身体：“被你看过了身子，我已经不干净了，以后怎么娶老婆，你得对我负责！”
柳盈盈蹙眉道：“少油嘴滑舌，女儿要听你讲睡前故事。”
想到叶凡没睡衣，又蹬蹬蹬跑上楼，再回来时手上多了一件黑色睡裙。
她扬起唇角：“你先穿我这件吧。”
叶凡怀疑柳盈盈是蓄意报复，男人的尊严让他义正言辞的拒绝了。
“我叶凡就是死，死外边，从房顶跳下去，今天也不可能穿！”
“哦……”
柳盈盈拖着长音，将房门开到最大。
楼上传来小叶子糯糯的喊声：“爸爸，爸爸给我讲故事，爸爸快来呀~”
“行，你狠！”
为了闺女，叶凡咬牙认了。
睡裙是蚕丝的，本该穿在身上滑溜溜，但由于体型缘故，叶凡穿起来像紧身衣。
羞耻。

太羞耻了！
叶凡扭扭捏捏走出客房，柳盈盈眼疾手快掏出手机拍了张照片，又上下仔细打量一番。
“叶先生身材还挺好的呢，就是怕叶子看到后晚上做噩梦。”
柳盈盈后知后觉一拍额头：“哎呀，突然想起家里有一套没拆封的男士睡衣，我去找找。”
content_en:
"Okay mommy."
The little girl jumped up and down to wash her hands.
Four dishes and one soup are all very homely dishes, and the taste makes Ye Fan full of praise.
"Yingying, your skills are great."
"Yeah, yeah, Mommy is the best Mommy in the world, and the food she cooks is so delicious."
Ye Zi raised her cute and innocent little face, and while praising, she secretly picked the vegetables from the bowl into Ye Fan's bowl, and then ate the meat.
"..." Ye Fan.
"..." Liu Yingying.
Children are always like this. They think what they do is perfect, but in fact it's just their parents who don't want to expose it.
Liu Yingying also pretended not to see it this time.
Maybe it was because he was tired from playing, so Ye Zi ate half a bowl of rice more than usual. After eating, he even touched his belly, which was very cute.
"Yi Zi, I'm going to put in the water. I'm going to take a bath soon."
"Dad is coming too."
Good girl!
Ye Fan almost agreed.
But when he met Liu Yingying's plain eyes, Ye Fan persuaded her earnestly: "Yi Zi, you are a five-year-old girl, and dad can't accompany you."
"Okay."
The little girl was a little disappointed.
Ye Fan played with little leaves with blocks for a while, and after his daughter was called away by Liu Yingying, he reluctantly went to the guest bedroom on the first floor.
Because he didn't have a change of clothes, Ye Fan lay naked on the bed after taking a bath to let his thoughts go.
Compared with the rich spiritual energy in Kunlun Mountain, the spiritual energy in the villa and within a ten-mile radius was so thin that it was almost non-existent, so Ye Fan did not breathe in, but stared at the moonlight in a daze.
The moonlight is so beautiful tonight.
It’s much more beautiful than the moon on Kunlun Mountain.
"Ye Fan, are you asleep?"
Liu Yingying opened the door and Xiafei blushed, because the light was on and everything was in full view.
She turned around quickly and said angrily: "Why aren't you wearing any clothes?"
"Why didn't you knock on the door?"
Ye Fan covered his body in panic: "You have looked at my body and I am no longer clean. You have to be responsible for me how to marry a wife in the future!"
Liu Yingying frowned and said, "Stop being so glib. My daughter wants to hear your bedtime story."
Thinking that Ye Fan had no pajamas, he ran upstairs again, and when he came back, he had a black nightgown in his hand.
She raised the corners of her lips: "You can wear my piece first."
Ye Fan suspected that Liu Yingying was deliberately retaliating, and a man's dignity made him refuse righteously.
"Even if I, Ye Fan, die, die outside, or jump from the roof, I won't be able to wear it today!"
"Oh..."
Liu Yingying drew a long note and opened the door as wide as possible.
Little Ye Zi’s Nunuo shouting came from upstairs: “Dad, daddy, tell me a story, daddy, come quickly~”
"Okay, be cruel!"
For the sake of his daughter, Ye Fan gritted his teeth and admitted it.
The nightgown was made of silk and should have been slippery on the body, but due to his body shape, it looked like a tights on Ye Fan.
shame.
What a shame!
Ye Fan walked out of the guest room nervously. Liu Yingying quickly took out her mobile phone and took a photo, then looked up and down carefully.
"Mr. Ye is in pretty good shape, but I'm afraid Ye Zi will have nightmares at night after seeing him."
After realizing it, Liu Yingying slapped her forehead: "Oh, I suddenly remembered that I have an unopened set of men's pajamas at home. I'll go look for it."
